schema_version.description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

case_version_id.description: This identifier refers to one immutable case version.

delivery_audio_sha256.description: This hash identifies the final audio file that reviewers assessed.

policy_version.description: This field identifies the fixed policy that governs the parent operation.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

type.description: This field selects the typed evidence or source-reference class.

status.description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

observed_value.description: This field contains the measured feature value in its declared unit.

unit.description: This field identifies the measurement unit declared by the parent object.

threshold_id.description: This identifier refers to an approved threshold, not a model-selected limit.

evidence_ids.description: These IDs identify actual supporting records within the permitted subject and version scope.

reason.description: This field explains why a metric or decision is unavailable under the stated enumeration.

gates.description: These records contain the applicable publication checks and their evidence.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

reviewer_id.description: This identifier refers to the actual genuine human reviewer.

qualification_evidence_id.description: This identifier links the reviewer to actual qualification evidence.

phase.description: This field identifies the reviewer phase relative to key disclosure.

audio_sha256.description: This hash identifies the exact audio bytes for the observation.

approved_unit_ids.description: These unit IDs identify the targets that the reviewer approved.

rejected_unit_ids.description: These IDs identify units that the reviewer rejected.

observations.description: These entries retain the actual reviewer observations for the case.

decision.description: This field states the supported mapping outcome for one claim.

created_at.description: This field records the actual creation time with its timezone.

reviews.description: These records preserve independent review decisions and their evidence.

outcome.description: This field records the overall publication-check result.
